summary: Ground transponder testing at Amesbury, EGDM, between 0830 and 1730, may cause false aircraft indications within 3 nautical miles.
text:
GROUND TRANSPONDER TESTING. MODE S TEST TRANSPONDER LOCATED PSN 
510846N 0014531W (AMESBURY). POSSIBLE FALSE AIRCRAFT INDICATIONS
MAY OCCUR WI 2NM RADIUS. MAY INDICATE A SPEED OF 300KTS AND
99000FT AGL. DIRECT OVERFLIGHT BELOW 100FT SHOULD BE AVOIDED. 
SFC-UNL. FOR INFO 01980 663052. AR-2026-10378/01.
